data.sentence: Hi Derek, it's Sarah Chen from Aegis support — thanks for making time for the follow-up.
Hi Sarah. Sure, I figured we should close the loop on the sync issue.
Absolutely. This is case 8124, which I opened as the follow-up to 7615 after we moved you to a dedicated sync worker.
How have policy changes been propagating for you since then?
Honestly, much better. The last few policy changes went through in under five minutes, most of them in about two.
We did a big group restructure last Thursday — around three hundred users moving between groups — and that took about twelve minutes.
That lines up with what I see in the logs. Twelve minutes for a bulk move that size is within the normal range on a dedicated worker.
Good. The other thing I wanted to check was provisioning for new hires — we had a class of twenty start Monday.
I can see those. All twenty accounts were provisioned within three minutes of the HR sync, and their access packages applied.
Great, that's what I needed to hear. Our onboarding team was nervous after last month.
I do want to say, though — the five days without a response on the original case still bothers me.
We're a wealth management firm. If a terminated employee keeps access for four hours, that's a regulatory problem, not an inconvenience.
You're absolutely right, and I'm sorry that happened. We've made a change since then.
P2 cases now page the on-call support engineer if there's no human response within eight business hours, so nothing sits in a queue for days.
Okay. That's the kind of thing I'd want to see in writing for our vendor review.
I'll include it in the case closure summary.
One more thing — is there a way for us to see sync latency ourselves, instead of calling you?
Not in the console today. There's an API endpoint for sync job status, and I can send you a sample script that pulls it.
A dashboard would be better, but a script works for now. Is a dashboard on the roadmap?
I'll log it as a feature request with the Identity product team — I know they're building an audit trail view that might include it.
Please do. If we can watch it ourselves, my team will sleep a lot better.
Before we close it, I'd suggest monitoring for one more week, and if latency stays under ten minutes, I'll resolve the case.
That's fine. And the dedicated worker — is that permanent, or does it get reverted at some point?
It's permanent for your tenant. It's flagged on your account so it won't be touched in future rebalances.
Okay, good. Thanks Sarah, I appreciate you following up proactively — that's what was missing last time.
Thank you, Derek. I'll send the summary and the script today.
